sloka: संभ्रान्त मनसः सर्वे तेन वाक्येन चोदिताः ।ते गत्वा राज भवनम् विश्वामित्रम् ऋषिम् तदा ॥१-१८-४१॥
transliteration: saṁbhrānta manasaḥ sarve tena vākyena coditāḥ ।te gatvā rāja bhavanam viśvāmitram ṛṣim tadā ॥1-18-41॥

translations.english: Having heard their words, Dasaratha in great joy went forth together with his preceptors to receive him like Indra receiving Brahma.
